function.name: read_artifact_file
function.description: Reads one file of an artifact by its path, from the latest version unless you name one. Text files, such as Markdown, HTML, CSS, scripts, and SVG, come back as numbered lines: a line number, then a tab, then the line, numbered from 1. By default it reads up to 2000 lines from the start; offset and limit read another stretch of a long file. Images are shown to you. Other files, such as videos and PDFs, are described without their bytes. List an artifact's files with read_artifact.

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.
